spin.description: 0 (alpha) or 1 (beta) for a channel that is itself spin-resolved, which arises only in projections without a spin axis.

DosMetaPayload.description: The JSON payload named by the `meta` member of a `dos.coop` or `dos.cohp` section: what the pair axis of `projections` and `integrated` means, plus broadening and Fermi level. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Typed-open: the fields below are typed and further keys are allowed. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

n_spin.description: Number of spin channels; with 2, `projections` and `integrated` carry a leading spin axis.

fermi_energy_ev.description: Absolute Fermi level in eV (`energies` are referenced to it at 0).

pairs.description: The atom pairs, one per entry of the pair axis: [i, j], or an object {i, j, label?, symbol_i?, symbol_j?, distance_ang?} with 0-based atom indices and the distance in Å.

pair_labels.description: Display labels, one per entry of the pair axis.

channels.description: Channel objects, one per entry of the pair axis; a pair channel names its two atoms as i and j.

units.description: Optional map from a field name of this payload, or the role of a member of the section, to the unit name of its values. The units are fixed by QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions); a declaration restates them and does not change them, so `fermi_energy_ev` and `energies` are `ev`.

SectionStructureSymmetry.description: Symmetry analysis of a structure. The `data` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/SymmetryPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

SymmetryPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `structure.symmetry` section's `data` member: a symmetry analysis of the structure, as common symmetry finders report it. Permissive: the known fields are typed, the root stays open, and a later revision may tighten the definition. See QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

spacegroup_number.description: Space-group number of the International Tables for Crystallography.

hall.description: Hall symbol of the space group.

point_group.description: Point-group symbol; Schoenflies notation is recommended, e.g. 'C2v'.

hermann_mauguin.description: The point group in Hermann-Mauguin notation, e.g. 'mm2'.

space_group_number.description: The same quantity as `spacegroup_number`, under the name some producers write. When both are present they MUST agree.

space_group_symbol.description: The same quantity as `international`, under the name some producers write. When both are present they MUST agree.

operations.description: Symmetry operations x' = R x + t. For a periodic structure R and t act on fractional coordinates of the structure's lattice; for a molecule R acts on Cartesian coordinates and t is zero or absent.

wyckoffs.description: Wyckoff letter of each atom, in the order of the structure's atoms.

equivalent_atoms.description: For each atom, the 0-based index of the representative atom of its symmetry-equivalence class.

symprec.description: Distance tolerance of the symmetry search, in Angstrom.

SectionBonds.description: Explicit connectivity of a structure as atom pairs. The `bonds` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/BondsPayload`, as is the optional `bonds` member of a `structure` section. The atom indices address the atoms of the structure the section's `structure_ref` names, else of the archive's first structure; an archive with several structures SHOULD set `structure_ref`. See QVF spec § 5.1 (structure and bonds).

BondsPayload.description: The JSON payload of a `bonds` section's `bonds` member and of a `structure` section's optional `bonds` member: explicit connectivity as atom pairs. Strict: no keys other than those listed, except extension keys beginning with `x_`, here and in every pair. See QVF spec § 5.1 (structure and bonds) and § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

i.description: 0-based index of one atom in the structure's atoms.

SectionBondOrders.description: Bond-order table — Mayer / Wiberg bond orders with atom-pair labels and distances. The `bond_orders` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/BondOrdersPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

BondOrdersPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `bond_orders` section's `bond_orders` member: computed bond orders per atom pair. Strict: no keys other than those listed, except extension keys beginning with `x_`, here and in every pair. See QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

method.description: Bond-order definition. Lowercase names are recommended, e.g. 'mayer', 'wiberg' or 'nbo'.

i.description: 0-based index of one atom in the structure's atoms.

order.description: Bond order under `method`. Some definitions yield small negative values, so the sign is not constrained.

distance_ang.description: Distance between the two atoms, in Angstrom.

SectionSCFHistory.description: Per-iteration SCF convergence record. The `iterations` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/ScfHistoryPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

ScfHistoryPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `scf_history` section's `iterations` member: one record per SCF iteration. Strict: no keys other than those listed, except extension keys beginning with `x_`, here and in every record. See QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

iter.description: Iteration number, as the producer counts them.

energy_eh.description: Total energy after the iteration, in Hartree.

delta_e.description: Energy change from the previous iteration, in Hartree.

diis_error.description: DIIS error norm, in atomic units.

rms_density_change.description: Root-mean-square change of the density matrix from the previous iteration, in atomic units.

converged.description: Whether the SCF met its convergence criteria. Absent means not stated.

CitationsReferences.description: BibTeX bytes are carried as a binary member; consumers decode as UTF-8.

OpaqueBinaryMember.description: Opaque bytes carried as a binary member with no dtype/shape. The owning section kind defines the payload's encoding (e.g. UTF-8 text for run.record input/log).

SectionRunRecord.description: Self-contained record of one program invocation: the verbatim input handed to a quantum-chemistry code and/or the full log/output it produced, plus auxiliary attachments. `program` names the code the input/log belong to — which may differ from the root `source.program` when the archive was written by a converter. `input` and `log` are opaque binary members that MUST decode as UTF-8 text; `attachment.*` members carry arbitrary bytes described by the optional `files` index.

program.description: The program that consumed `input` / produced `log` (e.g. 'vibe-qc', 'orca'). Lowercase identifiers recommended.

command.description: Command line used to launch the run, as one string.

sequence.description: Ordering index when an archive carries multiple run records (multi-step workflows).

job_ref.description: Id of the `job.spec` section this run executed. It must name a section of kind `job.spec` in this archive. In an archive with several `job.spec` sections (a job set) it is how a reader tells which job ran; see QVF spec § 5.8 (run.record — self-contained run records) and QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification), under Job sets.

run_status.description: Outcome of this run, with the meanings of the root provenance.run_status. In a job set it is the status of the job that `job_ref` names; see QVF spec § 5.8 (run.record — self-contained run records).

RunRecordFilesPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `run.record` section's `files` member: an index from member role to what the member was before it was embedded. Every key names a member of the same section (`input`, `log` or an `attachment.<suffix>`), so the index has no vendor escape at its top level; each entry is strict apart from keys beginning with x_. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. See QVF spec § 5.8 (run.record — self-contained run records).

description.description: What the file is, for display.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the bytes, e.g. 'text/plain' or 'chemical/x-xyz'.

truncated.description: True when the stored bytes are not the complete file, e.g. a log embedded before the run ended.

SectionJobSpec.description: Declarative specification of the calculation an archive requests — before, and independent of, any results it carries; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification). Together with a `structure` section it makes the archive an executable input: a runner reconstructs the job from the `spec` payload, executes it, and writes results plus a `run.record` back into the same container. The payload is declarative data, never code.

JobSpecPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `job.spec` section's `spec` member (conventionally `job_spec/spec.json`). It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json, so nothing in the manifest $refs this definition — a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against it. The root is open for forward growth, but engine-specific keywords SHOULD live under `options`, keeping the typed top level portable across codes; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification).

job_type.description: Which class of engine runs the job. Periodicity of the geometry itself is carried by the structure section's pbc/lattice_vectors; job_type selects the runner, it does not restate periodicity.

method.description: Method identifier (e.g. 'rhf', 'rks', 'ccsd(t)', 'gfn2'). Producer-neutral lowercase recommended. Absent means the engine's default.

anyOf.description: Deprecated spelling of null, which producers SHOULD NOT write; consumers read it as null.

basis.description: Basis-set name (e.g. 'def2-svp'), or null: the method takes no basis set (a semiempirical or tight-binding method). Absent means the engine's default. The empty string is a deprecated spelling of null; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification).

anyOf.description: Deprecated spelling of null, which producers SHOULD NOT write; consumers read it as null.

functional.description: Exchange-correlation functional name (e.g. 'pbe0'), for DFT methods, or null: the method takes no functional (Hartree-Fock, a correlated wavefunction or a semiempirical method). Absent means the engine's default. The empty string is a deprecated spelling of null; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification).

charge.description: Net charge. Absent means 0. Authoritative for the job — never inferred from the structure.

kpoints.description: [n1, n2, n3] Monkhorst-Pack mesh. Periodic jobs only.

tasks.description: Ordered task identifiers, e.g. ['single_point'], ['optimize', 'hessian']. Absent means a single point.

structure_ref.description: Id of the `structure` section the job runs on. A validator resolves it to a section of kind `structure`. A `structure_ref` on the `job.spec` section object takes precedence and is the preferred carrier, because it can be read from the manifest; producers keep the two equal. In an archive with several `structure` sections a job without either is ambiguous, and a runner refuses it; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification), under Job sets, and QVF spec § 4.1 (Section object).

dispersion.description: Dispersion correction, by its conventional lowercase name, e.g. 'd3bj' or 'd4'. Absent means none beyond what the method implies.

relativistic.description: Scalar-relativistic treatment, by its conventional lowercase name, e.g. 'zora', 'x2c' or 'dkh2'. Absent means none.

options.description: Additional engine-specific keywords (JSON-safe values). A runner that does not recognize an option MUST refuse the job rather than silently drop it.

JobSpecSolvation.description: Implicit solvation of a job: the `solvation` field of `JobSpecPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification). Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; engine-specific keywords go under `options`.

model.description: Solvation model, by its conventional lowercase name, e.g. 'pcm', 'cpcm', 'smd' or 'cosmo'.

epsilon.description: Static dielectric constant of the solvent, dimensionless.

JobSpecScf.description: Self-consistent-field settings of a job: the `scf` field of `JobSpecPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification). Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; engine-specific keywords go under `options`.

convergence.description: Convergence threshold of the SCF energy change, in hartree.

guess.description: Initial guess, by its conventional lowercase name, e.g. 'core', 'sad' or 'huckel'.

damping.description: Damping factor applied to the density or Fock update, dimensionless.

JobSpecGeometry.description: Geometry-optimisation settings of a job: the `geometry` field of `JobSpecPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification). Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; engine-specific keywords go under `options`.

convergence.description: Convergence threshold of the optimisation: the largest Cartesian gradient component, in hartree/bohr.

coordinates.description: Coordinate system the optimiser steps in.

JobSpecResources.description: Resources a job would like: the `resources` field of `JobSpecPayload`. These are hints, not requirements: a runner uses what it has and may use less. What a run actually used is recorded in `provenance` (`n_threads`, `n_mpi_ranks`, `n_gpus`, `wall_seconds`). See QVF spec § 5.9 (job.spec — declarative job specification). Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`.

n_cores.description: Number of CPU cores to use.

walltime_s.description: Wall-clock time to allow, in seconds.

SectionBasisAO.description: Basis-function visualisation — one atomic orbital (contracted shell or individual primitive) evaluated on a 3-D grid. The `ao_metadata` object carries per-function quantum numbers and provenance; the `grid` + `data` members follow the same contract as all volume.* sections.

angular_momentum.description: [l, m]. Element 0 is always the shell's angular momentum l. Element 1 is the real-spherical-harmonic index m in [-l, +l] and is meaningful ONLY when `cartesian_powers` is absent; when `cartesian_powers` is present the component is a Cartesian monomial with no magnetic quantum number, element 1 is 0 by convention, and a consumer MUST ignore it. See QVF spec Appendix A.3.

cartesian_powers.description: [lx, ly, lz] powers of the Cartesian monomial this AO is, with lx+ly+lz == angular_momentum[0]. Present if and only if the AO is a component of a Cartesian (`pure: false`) shell, which has (l+1)(l+2)/2 components rather than 2l+1 and therefore no m. Absent for spherical AOs.

SectionEquationOfState.description: Equation of state — volume-energy data points and fitted EOS parameters. Specified in QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

EosFitPayload.description: The JSON payload named by an `equation_of_state` section's `fit` member: the fitted equation-of-state model and its parameters. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

model.description: The fitted E(V) form: third-order Birch-Murnaghan, Murnaghan, Vinet, third-order Poirier-Tarantola, or a polynomial in V from which V0, E0, B0 and B0_prime are derived.

B0.description: Bulk modulus at V0 in GPa.

B0_prime.description: Pressure derivative of the bulk modulus at V0, dimensionless.

residual_rms.description: Root-mean-square residual of the fit over the data points, in eV.

n_points.description: Number of (volume, energy) points the fit used.

pressures_gpa.description: Pressure of the fitted model at each volume point, in GPa, parallel to `volumes`.

energy_unit.description: Informational restatement of the energy unit, eV; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

volume_unit.description: Informational restatement of the volume unit, Å³; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

pressure_unit.description: Informational restatement of the pressure unit, GPa; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

SectionFermiSurface.description: Fermi surface — 3D k-space energy grid near E_F for metallic periodic systems. Specified in QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

FermiMeshPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `fermi_surface` section's `mesh` member: the k-point mesh that the first three axes of `energies` sample, and the cell it lives in. Grid point (i1, i2, i3) of a uniform mesh lies at fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates (i1/nk1 + shift[0], i2/nk2 + shift[1], i3/nk3 + shift[2]). It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

shape.description: Mesh dimensions [nk1, nk2, nk3]; equal to the first three axes of `energies`.

nk1.description: Mesh dimension along b1 as a separate key; equals shape[0] when both are present.

nk2.description: Mesh dimension along b2; equals shape[1] when both are present.

nk3.description: Mesh dimension along b3; equals shape[2] when both are present.

shift.description: Position of grid point (0, 0, 0) in fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates. Absent means a Γ-centred mesh.

symmetry_expanded.description: True when the producer filled the full mesh by applying symmetry operations to an irreducible set of computed k-points.

kpoints.description: Explicit fractional coordinates of every grid point, for a mesh that is not uniform: entry (i1 * nk2 + i2) * nk3 + i3 is grid point (i1, i2, i3). When present it replaces the uniform-mesh formula.

fermi_energy_ev.description: Absolute Fermi level in eV; `energies` hold E(k) - E_F.

n_spin.description: Number of spin channels of the underlying calculation.

band_indices.description: 0-based index, in the producer's full band list, of each band along the last axis of `energies`.

lattice_vectors.description: Real-space cell as three row vectors in Å (the structure convention); the reciprocal lattice follows from it.

reciprocal_lattice.description: Reciprocal lattice vectors b1, b2, b3 as rows, in 1/Å, including the 2π factor (a_i · b_j = 2π δ_ij).

units.description: Optional map from a field name of this payload, or the role of a member of the section, to the unit name of its values. The units are fixed by QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions); a declaration restates them and does not change them, so `fermi_energy_ev` and `energies` are `ev` and `lattice_vectors` is `angstrom`.

SectionPhononBands.description: Phonon band structure — q-path and phonon frequencies along a Brillouin-zone path, with optional phonon eigenvectors. Specified in QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

eigenvectors.description: OPTIONAL phonon eigenvectors, float64: [n_q, n_modes, n_atoms, 3] when real, or [n_q, n_modes, n_atoms, 3, 2] when complex, with the last axis [re, im] as for complex wavefunction.gto coefficients. The first two axes match `frequencies`. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

QpathPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `phonon_bands` section's `qpath` member: the q-point path the frequencies are sampled on, laid out like a bands kpath. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. No field is required. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

kpoints.description: Fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates of every q-point along the path, in the order of frequencies axis 0.

labels.description: One label per q-point along the path; an empty string marks an unlabelled point.

segments.description: The straight segments of the path, in path order.

n_kpoints.description: Number of q-points along the path; equals frequencies axis 0.

n_atoms.description: Number of atoms in the cell.

n_modes.description: Number of phonon branches (3 n_atoms); equals frequencies axis 1.

has_eigenvectors.description: Whether the section carries mode eigenvectors.

channels.description: Projection channels of atom-resolved phonon bands.

title.description: Display title of the phonon band structure.

units.description: Optional map from a field name of this payload, or the role of a member of the section, to the unit name of its values. The units are fixed by QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions); a declaration restates them and does not change them, so `frequencies` is `cm-1`.

SectionPhononDOS.description: Phonon density of states — frequency grid and total phonon DOS, with an optional projected phonon DOS. Specified in QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

projected.description: OPTIONAL projected phonon DOS, float64 [n_channels, n_points]: row c is the DOS projected on channel c, on the `frequencies` grid. The `channels` array of the `meta` member labels the rows, in order. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

PhononMetaPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `phonon_dos` section's `meta` member: counts, broadening, and the channels of a projected phonon DOS. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Typed-open: the fields below are typed and further keys are allowed; an empty object is valid. See QVF spec § 5.6 (Bands, DOS, and periodic kinds).

n_atoms.description: Number of atoms in the cell.

channels.description: Channels of a projected phonon DOS, one per projection row.

units.description: Optional map from a field name of this payload, or the role of a member of the section, to the unit name of its values. The units are fixed by QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions); a declaration restates them and does not change them, so `frequencies` is `cm-1`.

SectionTopologyQTAIM.description: QTAIM topological analysis — critical points and bond paths from electron-density topology. The `critical_points` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/QtaimPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

QtaimPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `topology.qtaim` section's `critical_points` member: critical points of the electron density and the bond paths joining them. Permissive root with typed points: the known fields are typed, the root and each point stay open, and a later revision may tighten the definition. Every position (a point's `position`, a bond-path vertex) is Cartesian, in the unit `units.position` declares, and in Angstrom, the unit of the structure the points overlay, when that is absent. The default is provisional pending a maintainer decision, so producers SHOULD declare `units.position`; see QVF spec § 5.7 (Analysis kinds).

type.description: Critical-point type by Hessian signature: bond (3,-1), ring (3,+1), cage (3,+3), nuclear (3,-3).

position.description: Cartesian position, in the unit `units.position` declares (default Angstrom).

laplacian.description: Laplacian of the electron density at the point.

ellipticity.description: Ellipticity of the density at the point; meaningful for a bond critical point.

atom_pair.description: For a bond critical point: 0-based indices of the two atoms it connects.

atoms.description: 0-based indices of the atoms the point belongs to, e.g. the nucleus of a nuclear critical point or the ring atoms of a ring critical point.

bond_paths.description: Gradient paths of the density joining two nuclei through a bond critical point.

atoms.description: 0-based indices of the two atoms the path joins.

path.description: Vertices of the path as a polyline, in the position unit.

units.description: Unit names of the payload's numeric fields. `position` names the unit of every position; another key names the unit of the point field of the same name, for which v1 fixes no default; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

position.description: Unit name of every point position and bond-path vertex, a length. Absent means 'angstrom'.

SectionForces.description: First derivatives of the energy at one geometry: the nuclear energy gradient (the forces are its negative) and, for a periodic system, the stress. The gradient rows follow the atoms of the structure named by the section-level structure_ref when present, else by meta.structure_ref, else of the archive's only structure section. See QVF spec § 5.10 (forces — nuclear gradient and stress).

ForcesGradient.description: The energy gradient dE/dR, float64 [n_atoms, 3], in hartree/bohr: row a holds the derivatives with respect to the x, y and z coordinates of atom a. The force on an atom is the negative of its row. That n_atoms matches the structure is checked by validators, not by this schema. See QVF spec § 5.10 (forces — nuclear gradient and stress).

ForcesStress.description: OPTIONAL stress tensor of a periodic system, float64 [3, 3], in hartree/bohr^3: sigma_ij = (1/V) dE/d(epsilon_ij) for the strain epsilon and the cell volume V, so the pressure is -(sigma_xx + sigma_yy + sigma_zz)/3. Symmetric. See QVF spec § 5.10 (forces — nuclear gradient and stress).

ForcesMetaPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `forces` section's `meta` member. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. No field is required. See QVF spec § 5.10 (forces — nuclear gradient and stress).

structure_ref.description: Id of the structure section whose atoms the gradient rows follow. A section-level structure_ref takes precedence when both are present.

method.description: Method of the energy that was differentiated, e.g. 'rks'.

convention.description: What the gradient member holds: 'gradient', the energy gradient dE/dR, is the only value in v1. Absent means 'gradient'.

DerivativeUnits.description: Declared units of an energy-derivative payload (forces, hessian): `energy` and `length` name the units the derivatives are taken in. v1 fixes them at hartree and bohr, so a declaration restates them and cannot name another unit; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

energy.description: Energy unit of the derivatives: hartree.

length.description: Length unit of the derivatives: bohr.

SectionHessian.description: Second derivatives of the energy with respect to the nuclear Cartesian coordinates at one geometry. The atoms are resolved as for a forces section. See QVF spec § 5.11 (hessian — Cartesian second derivatives).

HessianMatrix.description: The Hessian d2E/(dx_i dx_j), float64 [3N, 3N] for N atoms, symmetric; index i = 3a + c belongs to Cartesian component c (x, y, z) of atom a. In hartree/bohr^2, or hartree/(bohr^2 amu) when meta.mass_weighted is true. That the two extents are equal, divisible by 3 and match the structure is checked by validators, not by this schema. See QVF spec § 5.11 (hessian — Cartesian second derivatives).

HessianMetaPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `hessian` section's `meta` member. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. No field is required, but a mass-weighted matrix requires atom_masses_amu. See QVF spec § 5.11 (hessian — Cartesian second derivatives).

structure_ref.description: Id of the structure section whose atoms index the matrix. A section-level structure_ref takes precedence when both are present.

mass_weighted.description: True when element (i, j) of the matrix is divided by sqrt(m_a m_b) for the atoms a and b of i and j, with the masses of atom_masses_amu, which is then required. Absent means false.

projected.description: True when the rigid-body translations and, for a non-periodic system, rotations have been projected out of the matrix. Absent means false.

atom_masses_amu.description: Mass of each atom in unified atomic mass units, in atom order: one entry per atom, N in all.

SectionExcitedStates.description: Electronically excited states of one calculation (TD-DFT, CIS, ADC, EOM-CC and similar methods): a table of states with their excitation energies, transition properties and dominant orbital excitations, in the JSON member `states`, whose payload is `#/$defs/ExcitedStatesPayload`. A state may name its natural transition orbitals and its transition or difference density. See QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

wavefunction_ref.description: Id of the `wavefunction.gto` section of the reference state, usually the ground state, whose orbitals the `from_mo` and `to_mo` of the contributions index. It must name a section of kind `wavefunction.gto` in this archive; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

SectionPropertiesElectric.description: Electric multipole moments and polarizabilities of the system: the dipole, quadrupole and octupole, and the polarizability and hyperpolarizability, each in the fixed unit of the spec. The single `properties` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/ElectricPropertiesPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

ExcitedStatesPayload.description: The JSON payload named by an `excited_states` section's `states` member. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json, so nothing in the manifest $refs this definition; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against it. `states` lists the states in ascending order of their unique `index`; `meta` describes the calculation. That the indices are unique and ascending, that `meta.n_states` equals the number of states, that the references resolve and that the contributions index existing orbitals is checked by validators, not by this schema. Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

states.description: The excited states, in ascending order of `index`.

ExcitedState.description: One excited state of an `ExcitedStatesPayload`. Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

index.description: Number of the state, unique within the payload and counted from 1; the reference state is not listed. Spectrum peaks (`assignment.state_index`), natural transition orbitals (`mo_metadata.state_index`) and transition densities (`state_index`) name a state by this number.

excitation_energy.description: Vertical excitation energy: the energy of the state minus the energy of the reference state. Producers SHOULD write it in `ev`.

total_energy.description: Total energy of the state. Producers SHOULD write it in `hartree`.

symmetry.description: Irreducible-representation label of the state, e.g. 'B1'.

oscillator_strength.description: Oscillator strength of the transition from the reference state, dimensionless.

rotatory_strength_cgs.description: Rotatory strength of the transition from the reference state, signed, in units of 10^-40 esu^2 cm^2 (the '10^-40 cgs' unit quantum-chemistry programs print).

transition_dipole.description: Electric transition dipole moment between the reference state and the state, Cartesian components in atomic units (e bohr) in the axes of the section's structure. Its overall sign is arbitrary.

transition_magnetic_dipole.description: Magnetic transition dipole moment between the reference state and the state, Cartesian components in atomic units (e hbar / m_e, twice the Bohr magneton) in the axes of the section's structure.

contributions.description: The dominant orbital excitations of the state.

nto_ref.description: Id of the `wavefunction.gto` section that holds the natural transition orbitals of the state: its hole orbitals, since the hole and particle orbitals are two sections; see QVF spec § 5.3 (wavefunction.gto). It must name a section of kind `wavefunction.gto`.

density_ref.description: Id of the section that holds a density of the state on a grid: a `volume.transition_density` section, or a `volume.difference` section holding the density of the state minus that of the reference state.

ExcitedStateContribution.description: One orbital excitation of an excited state: from orbital `from_mo` to orbital `to_mo` of the reference wavefunction. Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

from_mo.description: 0-based row of the orbital the electron leaves, in the coefficient member of the reference wavefunction.

to_mo.description: 0-based row of the orbital the electron enters, in the coefficient member of the reference wavefunction.

spin.description: Spin channel of the excitation in an unrestricted reference: `alpha` indexes `mo_coefficients_alpha`, `beta` indexes `mo_coefficients_beta`. Absent for a reference with one set of orbitals.

weight.description: Weight of the excitation in the state: the squared amplitude X^2 (CIS, TDA), or X^2 - Y^2 (full TD-DFT, RPA), normalized so that the weights of all excitations of a state sum to 1.

ExcitedStatesMeta.description: Description of the calculation an `ExcitedStatesPayload` comes from. Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`. No field is required; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

reference_state.description: The state the excitations start from, e.g. 'S0'.

n_states.description: Number of states; equals the length of `states`.

tda.description: True when the Tamm-Dancoff approximation was used.

spin_flip.description: True when the states come from a spin-flip calculation.

units.description: Optional declaration of units, keyed by a field of the state objects, each value a unit name. `excitation_energy` and `total_energy` carry their unit in their own {value, units} objects, and a declaration restates it for every state; `oscillator_strength` is dimensionless. The transition dipoles and `rotatory_strength_cgs` have fixed units that no unit name names, so they are not declared; see QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions).

excitation_energy.description: Unit of the `excitation_energy` of every state.

total_energy.description: Unit of the `total_energy` of every state.

SectionPropertiesElastic.description: Elastic constants of a periodic system: the stiffness matrix in Voigt notation, in GPa, with optional compliance and isotropic moduli. The single `properties` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/ElasticPropertiesPayload`; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

SectionPropertiesDielectric.description: Dielectric response of a periodic system: the electronic, ionic and static dielectric tensors, the Born effective charges of the atoms and the piezoelectric tensor. The single `properties` member's JSON payload is specified by `#/$defs/DielectricPropertiesPayload`. The Born charges follow the atoms of the structure named by the section-level structure_ref when present, else of the archive's only structure section; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

Matrix3x3.description: A 3 x 3 matrix of numbers as three rows of three; row i holds the entries (i, x), (i, y), (i, z) of Cartesian components in the axes of the structure; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

Matrix3x6.description: A 3 x 6 matrix of numbers as three rows of six: the row is the Cartesian component x, y, z, the column a Voigt index in the order xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

Matrix6x6.description: A 6 x 6 matrix of numbers as six rows of six, in Voigt notation: row and column index the pairs in the order xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

Tensor3x3x3.description: A rank-3 tensor of numbers, 27 in all, in row-major order of shape [3, 3, 3]: element (i, j, k) is at index 9 i + 3 j + k, with Cartesian indices x, y, z = 0, 1, 2; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

ElectricPropertiesPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `properties.electric` section's `properties` member: the electric multipole moments and polarizabilities of the system, each block in the fixed unit of the spec. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed, here and in every block. At least one of dipole, quadrupole, octupole, polarizability and hyperpolarizability is required. See QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

origin.description: Reference point of the multipole moments, as `dipole_moment.origin` of the manifest root: a conventional name ('center_of_mass', 'center_of_nuclear_charge', 'origin') or an explicit 3-vector in bohr.

dipole.description: The electric dipole moment, in debye. When the manifest root also carries a `dipole_moment` block, the two statements must agree within 1e-6 debye; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

vector.description: Dipole vector components x, y, z in debye.

total.description: Magnitude of the dipole vector in debye.

units.description: Unit name of the dipole: debye. v1 fixes it, so a declaration only restates it.

quadrupole.description: The electric quadrupole moment, in debye-angstrom, in the Cartesian axes of the structure. `convention` names the moment the matrix holds and `traceless` says whether its trace is zero; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

matrix.description: Symmetric 3 x 3 quadrupole matrix in debye-angstrom, rows and columns x, y, z.

traceless.description: True when the trace of the matrix is zero. Always true for the buckingham convention.

convention.description: 'buckingham': the traceless quadrupole of Buckingham, half the sum of q (3 r_a r_b - r^2 delta_ab) over the charges. 'cartesian': the second moment, the sum of q r_a r_b over the charges, with its trace subtracted (one third of the trace on the diagonal) when `traceless` is true.

octupole.description: The electric octupole moment, in debye-angstrom^2, in the Cartesian axes of the structure; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

tensor.description: The 27 octupole components in row-major order of shape [3, 3, 3], in debye-angstrom^2.

convention.description: 'cartesian': the third moment, the sum of q r_a r_b r_c over the charges. 'buckingham': the traceless octupole of Buckingham, half the sum of q (5 r_a r_b r_c - r^2 (r_a delta_bc + r_b delta_ac + r_c delta_ab)). Absent means 'cartesian'.

polarizability.description: The electric dipole polarizability at one frequency, in atomic units; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

matrix.description: The polarizability tensor alpha_ab in atomic units (e^2 a0^2 / E_h), rows and columns x, y, z.

frequency_ev.description: Photon energy of the applied field in eV; 0 is the static polarizability. Absent means 0.

isotropic.description: The isotropic (mean) polarizability, one third of the trace of the matrix, in atomic units.

hyperpolarizability.description: The first electric dipole hyperpolarizability at one pair of frequencies, in atomic units; see QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

tensor.description: The 27 components beta_abc in row-major order of shape [3, 3, 3], in atomic units (e^3 a0^3 / E_h^2).

frequencies_ev.description: The two photon energies, in eV, of the applied fields of beta(-(w1 + w2); w1, w2); [0, 0] is the static hyperpolarizability. Absent means [0, 0].

units.description: Declared units, field name to unit name (QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions)): `dipole` is debye and `origin`, when it is a vector, bohr. v1 fixes both, so a declaration only restates them. The other fields have units that the vocabulary does not name; they are fixed by QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

origin.description: Unit of an explicit origin vector: bohr.

ElasticPropertiesPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `properties.elastic` section's `properties` member: the elastic constants of a periodic system in Voigt notation. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. The stiffness and compliance matrices must be symmetric, which validators check, not this schema. See QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

stiffness.description: The stiffness matrix C in Voigt notation, rows and columns in the order xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy, in GPa. Symmetric.

compliance.description: The compliance matrix S, the inverse of the stiffness matrix, in Voigt notation, in 1/GPa. Symmetric.

bulk_modulus_gpa.description: Bulk modulus in GPa, by the scheme `average` names.

shear_modulus_gpa.description: Shear modulus in GPa, by the scheme `average` names.

youngs_modulus_gpa.description: Young's modulus in GPa, by the scheme `average` names.

poisson_ratio.description: Poisson's ratio, dimensionless, by the scheme `average` names.

average.description: The averaging scheme of the four isotropic moduli: 'voigt' (uniform strain), 'reuss' (uniform stress) or 'hill' (their arithmetic mean). Absent means the scheme is not stated.

units.description: Declared units, field name to unit name (QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions)): `stiffness` and the three moduli are gpa, `poisson_ratio` is dimensionless. v1 fixes them, so a declaration only restates them. The compliance, in 1/GPa, has no unit name and is fixed by QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

stiffness.description: Unit of the stiffness matrix: gpa.

bulk_modulus_gpa.description: Unit of the bulk modulus: gpa.

shear_modulus_gpa.description: Unit of the shear modulus: gpa.

DielectricPropertiesPayload.description: The JSON payload named by a `properties.dielectric` section's `properties` member: the dielectric tensors, Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensor of a periodic system. It is an archive member, not part of manifest.json; a validator loads the member's bytes and checks them against this definition. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_ are allowed. That static equals electronic plus ionic, and that there is one Born tensor per atom of the structure, are checked by validators, not this schema. See QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

electronic.description: The electronic (high-frequency, clamped-ion) dielectric tensor, relative permittivity, dimensionless, rows and columns x, y, z.

ionic.description: The ionic (lattice) contribution to the static dielectric tensor, dimensionless.

static.description: The static dielectric tensor, dimensionless: the sum of electronic and ionic, to which it must agree within 1e-6 when all three are present.

born_charges.description: The Born effective charge tensor of each atom, in elementary charges, one 3 x 3 matrix per atom in atom order. Entry (i, j) is the polarization along i per unit displacement of the atom along j.

piezoelectric.description: The piezoelectric stress tensor e_ia in C/m^2: the row is the polarization component x, y, z, the column the Voigt strain index in the order xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy.

units.description: Declared units, field name to unit name (QVF spec § 4.3 (Units and numeric conventions)): the three dielectric tensors are dimensionless and `born_charges` is e. v1 fixes them, so a declaration only restates them. The piezoelectric tensor, in C/m^2, has no unit name and is fixed by QVF spec § 5.13 (Property kinds).

electronic.description: The dielectric tensor has no unit.

ionic.description: The dielectric tensor has no unit.

static.description: The dielectric tensor has no unit.

born_charges.description: Unit of the Born charges: e, the elementary charge.

SectionVolumeTransitionDensity.description: Transition density of one electronic excitation on a grid: the one-particle transition density between the reference state and an excited state, summed over spin, in e/bohr^3. Same members as volume.density (grid + data); its overall sign is arbitrary. The optional section fields name the `excited_states` section and the state. See QVF spec § 5.2 (volume.*).

excited_states_ref.description: Id of the `excited_states` section the state belongs to. It must name a section of kind `excited_states` in this archive; see QVF spec § 5.12 (excited_states — excited states and transition properties).

state_index.description: The `index` of the state whose transition density this is, in the `excited_states` section that `excited_states_ref` names, which is then required.

SectionPreview.description: A picture of the archive's contents for file managers, quick-look panels and catalogues: a raster `thumbnail` and an optional larger or vector `image`, both opaque binary members that carry their `media_type`. The picture of the archive is the thumbnail of the first `preview` section. An SVG image is self-contained and inert: no external resources, no scripts. See QVF spec § 5.15 (preview — a picture of the archive).

PreviewThumbnail.description: The raster picture of a `preview` section: PNG or JPEG bytes as an opaque binary member. Its longest side SHOULD be 256 to 1024 pixels and the member SHOULD be at most 1 MiB; see QVF spec § 5.15 (preview — a picture of the archive).

PreviewImage.description: A larger or vector rendering of a `preview` section's picture: SVG, PNG or JPEG bytes as an opaque binary member. An SVG document is UTF-8, references no external resource and contains no script; see QVF spec § 5.15 (preview — a picture of the archive).

SectionVendor.description: Vendor-namespace section. The `kind` must start with `x_<vendor>`; member shape is unconstrained except that every member is a valid JsonMember, BinaryMember or OpaqueBinaryMember (binary bytes without dtype and shape, which SHOULD carry their `media_type`); see QVF spec § 7.3 (Vendor namespace x_<vendor>.*).

Metadata.description: Descriptive metadata of the archive as a whole, so that it can be cited, found and traced. Every field is optional and none changes how the rest of the archive is read. Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`; see QVF spec § 3.5 (Root metadata).

title.description: Short human-readable title of the archive.

description.description: Free-text description of what the archive contains.

created_utc.description: When the archive was first written: an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ with an optional fractional second, e.g. '2026-10-07T12:00:00Z'.

modified_utc.description: When the archive was last changed, in the form of `created_utc`.

uuid.description: Identifier of this archive: an RFC 4122 UUID (version 1 to 8, RFC 4122 variant) in lowercase hexadecimal 8-4-4-4-12 form, e.g. '3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301'. Producers generate a random (version 4) one per archive.

authors.description: People or groups responsible for the contents, in citation order.

license.description: Licence of the archive's contents. An SPDX licence identifier or expression, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', is recommended.

doi.description: DOI under which the archive is published, without a resolver prefix, e.g. '10.5281/zenodo.1234567'.

keywords.description: Subject keywords for search and cataloguing.

derived_from.description: Archives or publications this archive was derived from, each given by its `uuid` or a DOI.

tags.description: Free labels for organising archives, not meant for publication.

MetadataAuthor.description: One author of an archive. `email` and `affiliation` are personal data that producers should not emit by default; see QVF spec § 3.5 (Root metadata).

name.description: Name as it should be cited.

affiliation.description: Institution. Personal data: emitted only when the person concerned asks for it.

email.description: Contact address. Personal data: emitted only when the person concerned asks for it.

ProvenanceSoftware.description: One program or library that produced the results of an archive, an item of `provenance.software`; see QVF spec § 3.2 (provenance). Strict: any other key is an error unless it begins with `x_`.

name.description: Name of the program or library, e.g. 'integral-lib'.

version.description: Version string, as the component reports it.

url.description: Where the component is published, e.g. its home page.

Thermochemistry.description: Thermochemical corrections at manifest root; see QVF spec § 3.3 (Root metadata blocks). All energy quantities in Hartree.

DipoleMoment.description: Dipole moment at manifest root; see QVF spec § 3.3 (Root metadata blocks).

origin.description: Reference point for the dipole: a conventional name for legacy producers, or an explicit 3-vector in bohr.

Constraints.description: Geometry optimisation constraints; see QVF spec § 3.3 (Root metadata blocks).

frozen_atoms.description: Zero-based indices of atoms frozen during optimisation.

Energies.description: Energies of the calculation; see QVF spec § 3.6 (Root energies). Every energy is a {value, units} object, and producers SHOULD write hartree. Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_. An energy stated here for the method that provenance.method names MUST agree with provenance.scf_energy, and components.zpve with thermochemistry.zpve_eh, within 1e-8 hartree; validators check this, which JSON Schema cannot express.

total.description: Energy of the archive's primary result.

method.description: Method of the primary result, whose energy `total` is, e.g. 'rhf', 'rks' or 'mp2'.

by_method.description: Energies of the same system by further methods, e.g. the SCF reference and the correlated energy of a post-SCF calculation.

units_note.description: Free-text note on the units, for people; it declares nothing.

EnergyComponents.description: Named contributions to an energy; see QVF spec § 3.6 (Root energies). Components may overlap and need not be exhaustive, so a consumer MUST NOT add them up to obtain the total. A key beginning with x_ names a further, producer-defined component.

one_electron.description: One-electron energy: kinetic energy plus electron-nuclear attraction.

two_electron.description: Two-electron energy: Coulomb plus exchange (Hartree-Fock) or Coulomb plus exchange-correlation (Kohn-Sham).

exchange_correlation.description: Exchange-correlation energy of a density functional.

exchange.description: Exchange energy: Hartree-Fock exchange, or the exchange part of exchange_correlation.

correlation.description: Correlation energy: the correlated energy minus its reference energy, or the correlation part of exchange_correlation.

zpve.description: Zero-point vibrational energy; equals thermochemistry.zpve_eh when both are present.

thermal.description: Thermal correction to the energy at thermochemistry.temperature_k, excluding zpve.

embedding.description: Interaction with an embedding environment, e.g. QM/MM or an embedding potential.

EnergyByMethod.description: The energy of the system by one method; see QVF spec § 3.6 (Root energies). Strict: only the fields below and keys beginning with x_.

total.description: Energy of the system by this method.

Extensions.description: Extension governance block. Maps a vendor namespace prefix, written with its `x_` (e.g. `x_orca`, matching the prefix of the namespace's section kinds), to its version, optional schema URI, and critical flag; see QVF spec § 7.4 (Root extensions block and per-section critical).
